brief:
Israeli occupation forces conducted a military raid on Sinjil town, located northeast of Ramallah, on Monday evening, Shehab Wire reported. The operation saw troops enter the Palestinian community as part of ongoing military activity in the area.

The incursion followed a pattern of regular Israeli military operations across the West Bank. No immediate reports detailed the specific objectives of the raid, the duration of the operation, or whether it resulted in arrests or casualties among residents.
